metadata.processing: Reprojected to WGS84 and clipped to the Underflow study rectangle. Flood boundary simplified at 0.000018 degrees (~2 m). Source area fields removed because geometry was clipped.
metadata.scope: Source shapefile covers Nairobi and Kiambu; displayed extract intersects the study rectangle. Coverage and cloud layers accompany the observed extent.
metadata.attribution: Analysis and production: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT); source imagery CNES 2024 / Airbus Defence and Space. No satellite imagery redistributed.
